name: Peraleda de la Mata (Spain)
description: White field with a green stripe near the top and another near the bottom, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Peraleda de la Mata (a tree, a bell and stars on red).
history: Municipal flag of Peraleda de la Mata; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Peraleda de la Mata arms — tree, bell and stars
